name: DroneBL (dnsbl.dronebl.org)
tier_rationale: Long-running community project with identifiable maintainers, public documentation and more than two years of track record (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Lists drones, open proxies and abused hosts reported by IRC networks and honeypots; classes are documented, listings can be stale.

dnsbl.title: DroneBL (DNS A answer 127.0.0.<class>; IPv4 reversed octets, IPv6 nibbles)

terms.quote: P045 cond 1 (binding council text): Per-list terms registry; a list is wired only once its entry is recorded. SpamCop and DroneBL are 'open' within their free-use terms.

dnsbl.notes: Quote: binding council text (P045 cond 1); research C0083 (test point answered 127.0.0.1 'testing class' for IPv4 and for the IPv6 nibble test point ::ffff:7f00:2 through public DoH, 2026-11-26). Queried through the core DoH layer. Used by dnsbl.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P045). DNS only: the list is queried through DNS A lookups (core DoH layer or the system resolver), never over HTTP, so the provider has no HTTP host. Every DNSBL counts as ONE 'spam' family vote in P171 consensus (upstream_family 'dnsbl', P045 cond 8).
